key_concepts: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction
When two objects interact, they exert equal but opposite forces simultaneously
Action-reaction forces act on two different objects
Action-reaction pairs do not cancel because they act on different objects
Force diagrams can represent action-reaction pairs
Walking forward involves the ground pushing back on the person
A car moves forward because the road pushes back on the tires
A rocket accelerates upward as expelled gases push downward
Action is the force exerted by one body on another
Reaction is the force experienced by the body acting on another
External forces originate outside a system and affect its motion
Internal forces originate within a system and do not affect its motion
